title: WISH Multicenter Manuscript Featured in Healthcare Well-being Offerings (HWO)
description: Our manuscript, “A Multi-Department Investigation of Occupational Well-Being, Systemic Features, and Organizational Outcomes in Anesthesiology Using the Well-Being Influencers Survey for Healthcare (WISH)”, has been featured in the June 2026 edition of Healthcare Well-being Offerings (HWO). HWO is a platform dedicated to curating and spotlighting impactful contributions to the healthcare well-being field, and aims to highlight timely, innovative, and thought-provoking publications that help move the field forward and keep stakeholders across disciplines informed.

title: Dr. Higgins Speaks at NAM Plenary
description: Presentation on measuring progress in healthcare worker well-being at the National Academy of Medicine's Plenary on Exploring Tools to Measure Progress.

title: Dr. Higgins on the Caring Greatly Podcast
description: Dr. Elliott Higgins speaks with Heart of Safety Coalition’s Liz Boehm on WISH and shifting the focus to the environmental factors that shape occupational well-being for health workers.

title: Dr. Higgins on the ACGME Well-Being Podcast
description: Dr. Elliott Higgins speaks with ACGME Vice President of Well-Being Dr. Stuart Slavin about WISH and emerging research on how cultures of well-being relate to critical outcomes in academic medicine.

title: Drs. Higgins and Vinson on the ACCRAC Podcast with Jed Wolpaw
description: Drs. Elliott Higgins and Amy Vinson join ACCRAC host Dr. Jed Wolpaw to discuss WISH and how it is changing the conversation on how we advocate for, research, and improve well-being in perioperative medicine and beyond.

title: UCLA Newsroom: WISH Press Release
description: A UCLA-led research team has developed a new tool designed to measure the root-cause drivers of healthcare worker well-being. Going beyond traditional assessments of burnout and professional fulfillment, the tool evaluates the systemic factors that influence well-being across the healthcare workforce.

title: WISH Team at the ASA Annual Meeting: Tackling the Well-Being Crisis
description: Read about Drs. Higgins, Margolis, and Vinson at the 2025 American Society of Anesthesiologists Annual Meeting in San Antonio, Texas, presenting on WISH and the broader well-being crisis in anesthesiology and beyond.
